hero.lead: Stack A Butter Squishy is a Roblox ASMR simulation game where you pull a lever to generate random squishies, dip them in wax, and stack them on your plate to earn passive income. Squishies continue making money and wax keeps pouring even when you're offline. This wiki covers the core loop, codes status, pets, wax mechanics, money strategies, and update tracking to help you build your collection efficiently.

sections.heading: How to Play Stack A Butter Squishy: Beginner Roadmap
sections.intro: Start each cycle by walking to the lever and pulling it to spawn a random squishy. The lever generates one squishy at a time, so you'll repeat this step as you expand your stack. Once the squishy appears, pick it up and carry it to the nearest wax cup. Place the squishy into the cup and wait while wax pours over it—this step adds the finishing coating that prepares it for your plate.
paragraphs: When the waxing animation finishes, the completed squishy automatically jumps onto your plate and begins generating money passively. You don't need to collect each coin manually; the squishy produces income continuously as long as it remains on your plate. Repeat the lever-wax-plate sequence to add more squishies to your stack, and your total passive income climbs with every new addition.

Both wax pouring and income generation continue running even when you close the game. You'll return to accumulated earnings and any squishies that were mid-wax will have finished their coating cycle during your absence. This offline progression lets you grow your collection and bank balance without staying logged in around the clock.

sections.heading: Money, Upgrade Planning, and Offline Earnings
sections.intro: Once a squishy lands on your plate, it generates money automatically without further input. You collect the accumulated currency to buy cooler squishies from the lever pool, which typically earn at higher rates. Wax continues pouring and squishies keep earning even when you close the game, so you return to a stockpile of cash after offline sessions. This passive system rewards consistent logins and lets casual players progress without active grinding.
paragraphs: Early spending should prioritize expanding your plate capacity and unlocking higher-tier squishies that accelerate income. The money guide breaks down which upgrades deliver the best return and how to balance squishy variety against raw earning power as your collection grows.

sections.heading: Squishy Collection, Rarity Guides, and Tier List Criteria
sections.intro: As you earn money from your stacked squishies, you unlock the ability to purchase cooler and rarer squishies. The core appeal of Stack A Butter Squishy is building a diverse collection—each pull of the lever generates a random squishy, and over time you'll encounter different designs and varieties. Spending your passive income on new squishies keeps the gameplay loop engaging and gives you concrete progression milestones beyond just plate size.
paragraphs: The game features multiple squishy types and rarity tiers. Rather than all squishies being identical, the randomness on each lever pull means you'll gradually discover the full roster.
